name: Caltech Winter Open 2015

venue.name: [California Institute of Technology](http://www.caltech.edu/)
venue.details: Annenberg Center, room 105. See website for more details.

information: The cost of registration is $10 if you are doing four or fewer events, and $15 if you are doing five or more events.  If you do not pre-register online by Feb 16th, the fee will be doubled.  If you are a Caltech student, just show your student ID and the registration fee will be waived.  $1 per competitor goes to the WCA.
